title: Documentation support (MEAT) for chronic conditions
question: Which chronic condition, if any, is supported for risk adjustment by this note? Ignore the reason for the visit. Choose 'no code' if none is supported.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for depression.

HPI
The patient returns for a follow-up visit regarding their mood. They report that their symptoms have been manageable over the last month. They describe a steady mood with no significant episodes of increased sadness or loss of interest in activities. They report improved sleep patterns and consistent energy levels. They deny any suicidal ideation or plans for self-harm.

Medication List
Sertraline 100mg daily.

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented. They appear well-groomed with a stable affect. Speech is normal in rate and volume. Mood is reported as "okay." Cognition is intact.

Assessment
The patient has major depressive disorder, recurrent, moderate. The patient appears stable at this time.

Plan
The plan is to continue the current medication regimen. We will monitor their progress at the next scheduled appointment. The patient was instructed to contact the office immediately if they experience a significant worsening of symptoms.
explanations: The provider addressed recurrent moderate major depression: F33.1. Severity matters; unspecified recurrent MDD (F33.9) does not map to a V28 HCC.

distractors.why: The condition was addressed at the visit.
